title: General Training Writing Practice: Task 1 Letter

sections.instructions: Spend about 20 minutes on this task.

writing_prompts.prompt:
Your neighbour has been playing loud music late at night. Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter:
- describe the problem
- explain how it is affecting you
- suggest a solution

Begin your letter: Dear ...,
writing_prompts.instructions: Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
writing_prompts.examiner_notes: A neighbour letter can be friendly but should stay polite. A strong answer covers all three points, gives specific details (which nights, what time) and suggests a realistic solution, ending with an informal sign-off such as 'Best wishes'.
